Fig. 3 | Identification of kratom biosynthetic enzymes. a, MsCO1 and MsDCR1 
epimerize (20S)-corynantheidine (3a, 3S) to (20S)-isocorynantheidine

in N. benthamiana leaves infiltrated with indicated gene mixes. The shown data 
are representative spectra from biological replicates (n = 3). Compound peaks 
were determined via EIC from expected m/z values. Protein structures generated
